text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Hassan says Jerusalem has a special place in King Hussein's soul and is the reason why the monarch participated in the Washington summit.
- South African President Nelson Mandella expected to visit Jordan next week as part of a regional tour.
- Information Minister Muasher says Middle East crisis is passing through a crisis; emphasises that Jordanian-Palestinian ties are at their warmest level.
- King Hussein discusses in talks held in Washington with U.S. defence officials extent of American aid to the army's current rearmament and modernisation programme.

- Decisive role was played by King Hussein in the Washington summit, with the monarch warning of Palestinian despair and calling on Israel to implement earlier signed peace accords. Palestinian negotiators say monarch played a "heroic role for the sake of peace".
- Leading Islamist deputy Amoush calls on government to end the chapter of recent bread riots by release of all detainees arrested last August.
- Large fire in a paint factory on the outskirts of the capital causes extensive material damage.
